name: Segment Control
description: The segment control function code groups subsequent blocks into a scan cycle executed at a specified rate and priority. Each module can support up to eight segment control blocks. Each segment control block provides five outputs. Block address 15 contains one permanently configured segment control block. The other seven are configurable. NOTE: Online configuration allows changing the function block configuration during controller execution without interrupting the control process. For the HAC only, function code 82 can not be added or deleted via online configuration.
